content: The language used in Recommendation 4. Figure 4.1 in the same section has been updated to incorporate considerations of individual lifestyle choices, emphasizing the importance of tailoring treatment options to align with the unique preferences and circumstances of each patient. The immunization guidelines have been revised in light of the post-COVID-19 pandemic era. These updates include specific vaccination recommendations tailored to distinct patient groups, reflecting the evolving landscape of immunization needs following the pandemic.
